summary: Corrected the ROCm model-adjustment diagnostics so DeepSeek/GLM and GPT-OSS only log that AITER all-reduce fusion is enabled when the resolved enable_aiter_allreduce_fusion value is true. The intentionally disabled auto-enable behavior remains unchanged because no capability evidence justified restoring it. Added a full-resolution regression over DeepseekV3ForCausalLM, the reported GlmMoeDsaForCausalLM architecture, and GptOssForCausalLM using enabled/disabled, DP-attention, and node-count decision inputs.

tests.command: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-2b2bc2aa3c2d/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/test_model_overrides.py::TestGoldenModelOverrides::test_aiter_allreduce_fusion_log_matches_resolved_flag (with the original log condition temporarily restored)
tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression: both DeepseekV3ForCausalLM and GptOssForCausalLM logged enablement while the resolved fusion flag was false. Raw output: /job/artifacts/j-2b2bc2aa3c2d/regression-before.txt

Passing-after full argument-resolution regression: 12 subtests across DeepSeek V3, GLM MoE DSA, and GPT-OSS verified the resolved flag and matching log decision for disabled, enabled, DP-attention, and multi-node inputs. Raw output: /job/artifacts/j-2b2bc2aa3c2d/regression-after-final.txt

Broader file result: 91 passed and 4 unrelated host-dependent tests failed because CUDA/SM100 expectations were evaluated on the prepared ROCm host. Raw output: /job/artifacts/j-2b2bc2aa3c2d/test-model-overrides.txt

One MI350X (gfx950) executed a 128x128 by 128x64 float32 matmul; max absolute difference from an independently computed CPU result was 1.71661377e-05. This only confirms the assigned GPU environment, not distributed all-reduce. Raw output: /job/artifacts/j-2b2bc2aa3c2d/gpu-numerical.txt
Whitespace correctness and Python syntax for both changed source files.
The prepared interpreter has no ruff module, so lint execution was unavailable. Raw output: /job/artifacts/j-2b2bc2aa3c2d/ruff.txt

gpu_execution.evidence: A single-GPU numerical matmul ran on AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 under Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and matched an independently computed CPU reference. No distributed or AITER all-reduce execution was performed.

remaining_limitations: Only one GPU was assigned, so multi-rank AITER fused all-reduce execution and performance were not validated.

The change corrects diagnostics and deliberately does not restore auto-enable; the existing TODO provides no supported-device/version capability contract that would justify broad automatic enablement.
The complete test_model_overrides.py file has four unrelated ROCm-host failures in CUDA/SM100-specific expectations; the focused regression passes.
No native code changed, and repository-environment.json specifies no prepared native component, so no native rebuild was applicable.
